about: Field Records created by Field Academy 0.8.2 (record format 1, before the 0.8.3 reframe). Kept byte for byte so tests prove old records still verify.

does_not_show: It is competence shown in labs and on your own setup. It is not years of client work, and it does not promise how you will do with a real client.
The certificate is no Nous Research credential: Field Academy is a free community plugin that Nous Research has not reviewed.
Where Field Academy could not read Hermes, the certificate says so, and only the expert reviewer's acceptance counted.
The expert review is a proposal for Nous Research to consider. No reviewers are appointed yet.
deployer.issuer: Field Academy issues this certificate with an expert reviewer's signed sign-off. Field Academy is a free community plugin by Damon Gardenhire. Nous Research didn't make it and doesn't endorse it.
deployer.lifecycle_credit: The order of this path follows the lifecycle Tony Simons describes for his one-to-one Hermes architecture sessions at tonysimons.dev: audit what exists, design the boundaries, build and integrate, then test in isolation before production. Field Academy read it from a summary of his site. He has not reviewed this path and does not endorse it, and his site offers no certification.
deployer.name: Ada Lovelace
deployer.path_promise: Set up, deploy and manage Hermes for a small client: find what is wrong on their machine, decide what each helper may reach, run a real service for several days, break it on purpose and prove it recovers, then show an expert your work.
shows: That you repaired four broken client setups from their own files and logs, and the repairs passed checks you could not see in advance.
That you wrote a proposal for a fictional client that held up to the checks on price, access and refusing an unsafe request.
That you reasoned through nine cases with no clean answer.
That you ran a real service on your own Hermes for several days, and broke it and recovered it, as far as Hermes's own records could show.
That an expert reviewer you can name read all of it and signed it.
